ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
ayahs.en: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience
ayahs.e2: except those who have faith, do good, and urge each other to the truth, and urge each other to perseverance
ayahs.tr: Il lal lazeena aamanu wa 'amilus saali haati wa tawa saw bil haqqi wa tawa saw bis sabr
